title: ContextFidelity-Bench: code, data, and model outputs
description: Scenario generators, prompt material, 550 multi-turn model conversations with scored results, replication and supplementary collections, data-collection scripts, and the scoring and analysis scripts that reproduce every table and figure of the paper "ContextFidelity-Bench: A Three-Paradigm Framework for Evaluating Multi-Turn Hallucination Behavior in Language Models" (BenchCouncil Transactions on Benchmarks, Standards and Evaluations, 2026).
